theme.style: Dark Neon Cyberpunk & High-Tech Web3 Marketplace
theme.description: High-contrast dark theme with electric cyan, neon green, and cyber violet accents. Styled with glowing card borders, tactical glassmorphism, monospaced data readouts, and mobile-first bottom navigation.

gradients.dark_card_glow: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.08), transparent 60%)

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

desktop.top_nav: Sticky header with backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#07080C]/80 border-b border-[#1E2336]), brand logo with cyan glow, quick search input, balance badge with quick 'Add Funds' button, user vault, and role switcher (Buyer / Vendor / Admin).
desktop.layout_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 pb-24 md:pb-12

mobile.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom navigation bar (fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-[#0F111A]/95 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-[#1E2336] px-4 py-2 flex justify-around items-center md:hidden).

marketplace.components: Category filter tabs (Software, Templates, Assets, Subscriptions, Courses), search bar with instant filter, sort dropdown ('Newest', 'Best Sellers', 'Price: Low to High'), and neon card grid.
marketplace.card_style: Card UI with subtle border-[#1E2336], hover:border-[#00F0FF]/50 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.15)] transition-all group.

product_detail_and_buy.components: Product hero gallery/banner, stock indicator ('12 Keys Available' in neon green), instant buy modal using internal wallet balance, confirmation with automatic key generation & key vault storage.

wallet_and_add_funds.components: Wallet balance display with breakdown, crypto deposit modal/page with currency selector (BTC, USDT TRC20, LTC, ETH), target address + QR code, network mismatch warning banner, and TXID submit form creating a pending deposit request.

keys_vault.components: Secure digital license vault with masked keys (e.g. XXXX-XXXX-9821), instant 'Copy Key' button, download asset button, purchase timestamp, and vendor details.

vendor_dashboard.components: Vendor status badge, product listing editor (upload new product, manage key stock list line-by-line, set price, select category), sales analytics metrics, earnings overview, and withdrawal request submission.

admin_panel.structure: Dedicated tabs / sub-sections for distinct request types to avoid confusion:
sections: 1. Deposit Verification Queue (Approve/Reject user TXIDs with manual credit to wallet)
2. Vendor Withdrawal Queue (Review & process vendor payout requests)
3. Vendor Approval Queue (Approve or reject new seller applications)
4. Listing Approval Queue (Review & approve digital products before public listing)
5. Price Override & Commission Settings (Global % commission & per-vendor custom rates)
6. Crypto Address Management (Configure active platform deposit addresses for BTC, USDT, LTC, ETH)
7. Analytics & Global Audit Log (Track system activity, total volume, active users, system logs)

instructions_to_main_agent: Use React JSX syntax (not TypeScript) across components.
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, card, and metric includes a distinct data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='buy-product-btn-1', data-testid='admin-deposit-queue-tab').
Include mobile bottom navigation for quick access on smaller viewports.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for wallet top-ups, key copies, order completions, and admin status updates.
Make sure Admin Panel has dedicated sub-tabs for each queue type (Deposits, Withdrawals, Vendor Approvals, Listing Approvals) as explicitly requested.
Ensure dark mode is strictly enforced with high-contrast text and neon accent badges.
